title: Exceptions
description: Per-repo suppression list, keyed by findingId (finding.schema.json — a hash of ruleId + normalized location + repo, so it survives detector wording changes but stops matching once the code or rule changes). See plans/004-decision-layer-scoring.md and meetings/2026-07-22-1304-plan-004-kickoff.md in the security-skill-workspace repo for why this is a centralized file rather than inline code comments.

exceptionsVersion.description: Version of this exceptions schema (semver). Bump when the shape changes in a breaking way.

reason.description: Free text explaining why this finding is suppressed — becomes the finding's suppressionReason.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Once past, this exception no longer suppresses — prevents a 'temporary' suppression from silently becoming permanent. Omit for no expiry.
